justification: Requesting meropenem. Patient became hypotensive overnight requiring norepinephrine despite 30 mL/kg fluids. Failed 72h of piperacillin-tazobactam.

notes.body: 68M on HD MWF. Febrile 39.1, rigors after dialysis. Lactate 4.2. Started on vasopressors in ICU. Allergy list reviewed: denies penicillin allergy, tolerated amoxicillin in 2024. No history of C. difficile.
Admitted with tunneled line infection. Empiric piperacillin-tazobactam started 2/28.

septic_shock.description: Patient has septic shock (hypotension requiring vasopressors).

pcn_allergy_severity.description: Most severe documented penicillin allergy reaction; 'none' if explicitly no allergy.
